purpose: Teach: 早口/あだ名/ニュータウン/ドレッシング/餡/整頓/ポップアップ/シルエット

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、早口、絶対、で、絶対、お話、絶対、するよね
lines.en: Riku, you always talk so fast — like, seriously, you never slow down.
lines.style: Teasing lilt, not unkind. Quick rhythm matching her accusation. Eyes bright. The tone of someone pulling a friend's chain because she likes him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前の、本気で、絶対、あだ名、絶対、桜ちゃんって、絶対、皆、絶対、呼んでるよな
lines.en: Yeah. And everyone calls you Sakura-chan — like that's even a question.
lines.style: Quieter, steadier than her energy. A small smile underneath. Not defensive, just observing something obvious back at her. Mild, almost gentle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の家、本気で、絶対、ニュータウン、絶対、に、絶対、引っ越したんだよね、リク
lines.en: Your family moved out to the new development, didn't they? I can't believe it.
lines.style: Shift to softer curiosity. Less teasing, more genuine. Slight hesitation before his name — testing if the question matters. Vulnerable underneath the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 給食の、本気で、絶対、サラダの、絶対、ドレッシング、絶対、美味かったぜ、桜
lines.en: That dressing they put on the salad in the cafeteria — man, that was actually good.
lines.style: Deflecting, but not rudely. A small memory he's holding onto. Casual surface, tender underneath. The careful non-answer of someone who feels something but won't name it yet.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、餡、絶対、入りのお団子、絶対、持ってきてくれたよ、リク
lines.en: My grandma brought those bean-paste dumplings. The good ones.
lines.style: Brightness returning, but softer. Offering him a memory instead of asking him to share one. The generosity of changing the subject for his sake, while still letting him know she noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、机の上、絶対、整頓、絶対、しっかりしてるよな、桜
lines.en: Your desk is always so organized. It's kind of impressive, actually.
lines.style: Noticing something small about her that matters. Sincere praise, not performed. Slower pace — he's saying something true. Direct eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のスマホ、本気で、絶対、ポップアップ、絶対、通知、絶対、すごく、絶対、多いよね、リク
lines.en: Your phone is always blowing up with notifications. It's ridiculous.
lines.style: Wry observation, almost affectionate mockery. Light jab. The rhythm of someone calling out their friend's chaos because it's familiar and safe.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夕日の中の、本気で、絶対、お前の、絶対、シルエット、絶対、綺麗だったぜ、桜
lines.en: You looked beautiful in the sunset, Sakura. I mean that.
lines.style: Final vulnerability. Quiet, almost whispered. No cover, no joke. A moment where he stops deflecting and just says something true. Slight break in his voice like he's committing to being seen.
